tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces on canvas: cards, panels, inputs, menus.

tokens.name: sunken
tokens.usage: Recessed areas: code blocks, table headers, wells.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card borders. Structure comes from lines, never shadows.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, checkboxes) and the brand plus grid — 3:1 against canvas in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on canvas, surface, sunken (18:1 light, 17:1 dark). Also the main block in brand compositions.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, metadata on canvas and surface (6.6:1 light, 7.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Specianic Orange — THE brand colour, identical in both themes. Fills only: the mark, primary buttons, one highlight per view. Ink text on it (6.1:1), never white (3.1:1). Never text on light canvas (3.0:1).

tokens.name: signal-text
tokens.usage: Orange as text or icon: links, active nav, focus rings (5.0:1 light, 7.4:1 dark on canvas).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Healthy / passed. Text or icon on canvas (4.8:1 light, 9.5:1 dark). Always with a label.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions (6.3:1 both themes). Darker than signal in light theme so the two never read as the same colour; always with an icon and label — orange never means error.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero statements. One per page, never more than two lines.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Captions, metadata, helper text — in ink-muted.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase section labels and table headers. Same tracking as the wordmark.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code, CLI output, IDs, figures that must align.

styles.name: metric
styles.usage: Big numbers on dashboards and decks: latency, throughput, uptime.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Base unit. Icon-to-label gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside controls; between tightly related items.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button and input horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gaps between form fields; compact card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card and panel padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between groups inside a section; brand grid pitch.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Page-level breathing room; hero padding.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Default. Cards, panels, images, brand blocks, the mark. Square is the brand.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, tags — just enough to read as interactive.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status dots and avatars only.
